name: EH3D-LASER-CAM
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: a library and a command line that read a PNG or PGM image, turn it into dots (threshold, Floyd-Steinberg or Atkinson dithering) and write the G-code of a laser that burns line by line with M4 dynamic power, S0 while it travels, an overscan worked out from the acceleration and alternating directions, plus a power-against-feed calibration grid. No window, no vector cutting and nothing has been tried on a laser.
